channels.name: general
channels.description: Everyday kōrero for the whole collective

messages.text: Kia ora koutou — the pātaka kai working bee is confirmed for Saturday, 10am at the marae.
Ka pai! I can bring the seedlings and a couple of spades.
Perfect, ngā mihi Tama. I'll add you to the roster.
Anyone else keen? We could use two more pairs of hands.
I'll put a pānui up so everyone sees it.

project.name: Pātaka Kai Garden
project.description: Establish a community food garden at the marae, run by members for members.

milestones.title: Prepare the site
milestones.description: Clear, fence and mark out the beds.

milestones.title: Build and plant the beds
milestones.description: Six raised beds, soil, and the first season's seedlings.

milestones.title: First harvest and distribution
milestones.description: Harvest roster and distribution to whānau.

contributions.title: Clear and fence the site
contributions.objective: Make the site safe and ready to build on.
contributions.deliverable: A cleared, fenced site with a working gate.
contributions.acceptance: Site cleared, fence posts set, gate hung.

contributions.title: Build six raised beds
contributions.objective: Give the garden its growing space.
contributions.deliverable: Six raised beds, built to plan and filled with soil.
contributions.acceptance: Six beds built to plan and filled with soil.

contributions.title: Plant the first season
contributions.objective: Get the first season's kai in the ground.
contributions.deliverable: All beds planted, with a published watering roster.
contributions.acceptance: All beds planted and the watering roster published.

proposal.title: Adopt a monthly working bee roster
proposal.summary: That the collective adopt a standing monthly working bee, rostered across whānau, to keep the pātaka kai garden and marae grounds maintained without relying on the same few people each time.

notices.title: Working bee — pātaka kai garden
notices.summary: Bring gloves and a spade if you have one. Kai provided afterwards.

notices.title: Nau mai, haere mai to our newest members
notices.summary: Three new members were welcomed into the collective this month.

notices.title: Garden plan signed off
notices.summary: The pātaka kai implementation plan has been signed off and work starts this month.
